name: LocalChat
subtitle: Private on-device AI chat
description: Chat with open-weight language models running entirely on your phone. Models are downloaded from Hugging Face and run locally with llama.cpp — no account, no API key, no server. Nothing you type leaves the device.

apps.name: LocalChat
apps.subtitle: AI chat that never leaves your phone
apps.localizedDescription:
Privacy-first on-device chat. Browse and download public GGUF models from Hugging Face, then run inference locally with llama.cpp — no account, no API key, no network round-trip once the model is on disk.

The model browser filters by quantization and file size, and estimates whether a model will actually fit in your device's memory before you spend the bandwidth. Conversations are stored in local SQLite. English and French.

Requires a device with enough free RAM for the model you pick — a 4B model at Q4 needs roughly 3 GB.
